dedupe_keys.name: regagen data portal montenegro water wastewater and energy regulatory indicators

description: The Montenegrin regulatory agency for energy and regulated utility services (REGAGEN) runs an official data portal with charts and indicator series that can be filtered by sector and year. On 27 September 2026 it listed 25 series, among them for water and wastewater utilities: coverage of operating costs by operating revenue, collection rate, coverage of the population by wastewater collection and removal, coverage by treatment of municipal wastewater, the share of secondary treatment, compliance of effluent quality, the share of the sewer network inspected, and the share of wastewater sent to secondary or tertiary treatment. Energy series (electricity production and consumption 2015 to 2024, fuel station locations) sit on the same portal. Coverage is Montenegro's regulated utilities. Access is online and free through the portal, which also offers a price calculator. Caveats: the portal is in Montenegrin, the unit of aggregation (national or per utility) was not checked for each series, and no licence is stated. Simulation uses: utility performance and wastewater treatment indicators for benchmarking and planning models. Related records: ERRU Albania performance reports (data-erru-albania-water-operator-performance-reports) and SUNASS benchmarking (data-sunass-peru-utility-benchmarking).
